title: Launch
use: a listing, a partnership, a new pool — one thing that just went live, said in two headline lines

eyebrow.label: the small mono line, e.g. NOW LISTED or PARTNERSHIP

lineOne.label: first headline line — 22, down from 26: the title grew for mobile legibility and the frame is fixed, so the characters paid for it

lineTwo.label: second headline line, drawn in the brand accent — 22, down from 26: the title grew for mobile legibility and the frame is fixed, so the characters paid for it

support.label: one supporting sentence — 72, not 80: the support line rose to 38px so it survives a phone feed, and 38px only holds 72 characters inside the 1344px frame
